gui.essentialcraft5.animal_separator.own.en: No player placed this separator, so it won't work.
gui.essentialcraft5.animal_separator.own.zh: 这台分离器不是玩家放下的，不会工作。

gui.essentialcraft5.animal_separator.own.en: Break it and place it again: whoever places it becomes its owner.
gui.essentialcraft5.animal_separator.own.zh: 挖起来重新放下，放下它的人就是它的主人。

gui.essentialcraft5.animal_separator.own.en: The player who placed it is offline, so it is paused.
gui.essentialcraft5.animal_separator.own.zh: 放下它的玩家不在线，暂停工作。

gui.essentialcraft5.animal_separator.own.en: It resumes when they come back; redstone pulses in the meantime are not saved up.
gui.essentialcraft5.animal_separator.own.zh: 他上线后恢复；这期间的红石信号不会攒着补做。
